name: Siphon the Divine
body:
Prerequisite(s): Pool of providence class feature.

Benefit(s): Three times per day you can siphon power from a divine magic item to restore your pool of providence. With a full-round action you ruin the divine magic item (artifacts are immune) and regain a number of points in your arcane pool equal to the effective spell slot used to create it. An attended or intelligent item gains a Will save (DC 10 +1/2 your HD + your Cha modifier). Any points above your pool of providence’s maximum are lost.
